intro_text: You can make a difference. Project Battambang continually appreciates the generosity, partnerships, and time of volunteers who help serve underserved communities in Cambodia.
card1_desc: Every contribution goes directly towards medical supplies, village health clinics, referral subsidies, and student scholarships.
card2_desc: Support our cause through material sponsorships, medical equipment donations, or corporate partnerships to pave the path for better community health.
card3_desc: Calling all healthcare professionals, doctors, and student volunteers keen on joining our upcoming December 2026 trip or local groundwork initiatives.
